description.narrative: SummaryThe project is implemented in South Africa. The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights, equality and worker´s rights and just transition. The main rights holders are farmworkers, dwellers households, women, peri-urban and rural small-scale producers, land reform beneficiaries, vulnerable groups of people under communal land tenure, civil society organisations, trade and labour unions and land rights movements. Through workshops, dialogues and by creating solidarity networks the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is implemented with the support of the Olof Palme Memorial Fund.Trust for Community Outreach and Education (TCOE) works with rural poor in Eastern Cape and Western Cape, especially regarding the right to and redistribution of land. TCOE also collaborates with a number of small agricultural organisations with a membership base of over 15,000 people in order to support their self-sufficiency and their political capabilities. As a result of its close cooperation with the agricultural collective, TCOE has established itself as a voice in the discussion on the design of the land reform and related policy.The Olof Palme Memorial Fund for International Understanding and Common Security was established by Olof Palme s family and by the Social Democratic Party to honour his memory. The Fund s purpose is, through scholarships and grants, to give opportunities to young people for international exchange and for studies of peace and disarmament" support work against racism and against hostility toward foreigners" and to foster in other ways work for international understanding and common securityOther Donors to the OrganisationDonor funding linked to regional and national programmes from: DKA, NPA, CCFD, BCGMA, Bread for the world, Oxfam, Osisa, Fastenopfer, Apheda, AGS, AK, MOTT, Mama Cash, Southern Africa Trust.The Palme Center will organise a donors meeting with Bread for the world and other donors in order to clarify which components and activities are funded by whom in order to complement each other rather than overlap, but also to make it easier for TCOE when reporting.Project ObjectiveTo consolidate and expand operations in building the voice of the rural poor, especially women and farm workers.Actor groupsDecision makers:Department of Rural Development Land ReformCommercial FarmersLocal governmentParliamentariansDuty bearersActors in cooperation:Civil Society Organisationstrade and labour unionsLand rights movements (urban and rural)local formationsmedia housesRights holders:FarmworkersDwellers householdsWomenPeri-urban and rural small-scale producersLand reform beneficiariesVulnerable groups of people under communal land tenure.Civil Society Organisations:Trade and labour unions, Land rights movements (urban and rural), local formations, media houses, etc"
